lesson: The forecast over-anchored on India's stable supplier ranking and did not cover Venezuela. For monthly commodity-supplier questions, sanctions waivers, temporary shipping access and displacement from another source can reorder the marginal ranks quickly; direct reporting on those logistics should outweigh the historical table.
Direct club-role reporting correctly supported a near-certain Real Madrid forecast.

Czechia was covered only at 20% even though an April 7 report directly described the Czech government's planned tightening. Target-specific current evidence should outweigh a generic Poland-policy analogue even when the remaining formal approval pathway creates uncertainty; use the ground-truth-preferred country name Czechia when it appears in reporting.

The Third Circuit's rejection and pending en banc request correctly implied that the next distinct court would most likely be the Supreme Court, validating the procedural-path update made one day before resolution.
